verdict.rationale: Card Tables let teams set up their own columns and move work through phases, which is a first-party way to define workflow stages. Templates can carry the same workflow setup across projects. Nothing in the evidence shows custom fields on to-dos or cards. Missing for 10: custom field definitions, explicit configurable status values beyond kanban columns, depth documentation on workflow customization, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Card Tables are our take on kanban boards. Add cards, set up columns, and move work through phases.
Perfect for bug and issue tracking, software development, production work, or anything with distinct stages.
Create reusable project and to-do list templates with the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects.
